title: Manager - Finance - Rail & Inland Terminals - Modinagar
description:
**Job Description**
Job title - Manager Finance - Rail & Inland Terminals
  
  
Department - finance
  
  
Job location - DP World Rail Logistics Private Limited, ICD Modinagar, Kharkhoda Road, Mohiuddinpur, MEERUT, UP – 250205
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
Strategy, Planning and Management
  
  

* Assess and evaluate financial performance of organization with regard to long-term operational goals, budgets and forecasts.
* Provide insight and recommendations to both short-term and long-term growth plan of organization.
* Identify, acquire and implement systems and software to provide critical financial and operational information.
* Evaluate departments and make suggestions for automating processes and increasing working efficiency.
* Communicate, engage, and interact with Board of Directors, CEO and Executive Leadership Team.
* Create and establish yearly financial objectives that align with the company’s plan for growth and expansion.
* Serve as a key member of executive leadership team and round table discussion panel.
* Participate in pivotal decisions as they relate to strategic initiatives and operational models.
* Interact with and bring department into line with Board of Directors’ plans, initiatives and recommendations.
* Implement policies, procedures and processes as deemed appropriate by senior leadership team.

**Financial Analysis, Budgeting And Forecasting**

* Prepare and present monthly financial budgeting reports including monthly profit and loss by division, forecast vs. budget by division and weekly cash flow by division.
* Review and analyse monthly financial results and provide recommendations.
* Identify, develop and execute analysis of business initiatives, product launches, tenders issued by government/private organisations and/or new service offerings.
* Develop and maintain monthly operating budget and annual company operating budget.
* Manage financial planning and analysis department. Supervise creation of reports, software implementation and tools for budgeting and forecasting.
* Participate in weekly conference calls with KAM, Vendors and Executive Leadership Team.

**Accounting, General Ledger, Administration And Operations**

* Coordination with GSC for time bound billing. receipts tagging and revenue reconciliation.
* Check and control revenue leakages and customer ledger reconciliation.
* Update customers master data, review revenue GLs in Oracle, monthly revenue and operating expenses provisioning.
* Custodian of Billing Commercials, customer agreements and commercials including commercials of local transportation, ensure smooth conduct of internal, statutory and third-party audits, resolve customers issues.
* Supervise the accounting department to ensure the proper functioning of all systems, databases, and financial software. Provide regular maintenance and backup of all accounting systems and supervise company financial staff.
* Review and ensure application of appropriate internal controls, SOX compliance and financial procedures.
* Ensure timeliness and accuracy of financial and management reporting data for BU management, Rail PFT management, RO Finance, federal funders, foundations, investors, company’s board of directors.
* Oversee the preparation and timely filing of all local, state and federal tax returns.
* Work with Human Resources to ensure appropriate legal compliance.
* Oversee the month-end close process, constantly reviewing procedures while eliminating inefficiencies.
* Review all month-end closing activities including general ledger accounts, balance sheet accounts and overhead cost allocation.
* Enhance and implement financial and accounting systems, processes, tools and control systems.

**Financial Management**

* Explore new business/investment opportunities and provide recommendations on potential returns and risks.
* Maintain outstanding relationships and strategic alliances with vendors and business partners.
* Utilize forward-looking models and activity-based analyses to provide financial insight into the organization’s plans and operating budgets.

**Cash Management**

* Day to Day Collection Monitoring
* Supervise Accounts Receivable management and provide guidance relating to the collection process.

**Qualifications & Competencies -**

* Good Communication skills in English language, both oral and written.
* Qualification – Chartered Accountant worked with Corporate or Firm in Accounting and Finance Profile - Minimum -5 years.
* To have very good knowledge of word, excel & PPT as well as software.

title: Loan Manager – Assets
description:
**Company Description**
atyati Technologies, founded in 2006, is a financial technology company delivering comprehensive banking and financial services through a proprietary GANASEVA platform. With 100 offices and over 1,000 team members, atyati supports 21 banking and financial institutions and handles significant transaction volumes and advances every month. The organization plays a key role in financial inclusion across 27 states, serving millions of customers through Bank Mitras, CSPs, and doorstep banking solutions. atyati’s technology seamlessly integrates with core banking systems, offering services from financial transactions to credit and lending for rural, semi-urban, and urban customers. Its solutions are trusted by public sector banks, private banks, small finance banks, and institutions in India and Africa.
  
**Role Description**
The Loan Manager – Assets is a full-time, on-site role based in Sardhana, responsible for overseeing asset-based lending operations and portfolio performance. The role involves managing the end-to-end loan servicing cycle, including application review, documentation verification, disbursement coordination, and monitoring of repayment schedules. The Loan Manager will regularly analyze loan portfolios, track asset quality, and implement risk mitigation measures while ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory guidelines. Daily responsibilities include engaging with customers to address queries, resolving issues, coordinating with branch and field teams, and supporting collection activities where required. The role also involves preparing operational reports, identifying opportunities to improve processes, and contributing to business growth in the local market.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong knowledge of Loan Servicing and Loans, including end-to-end lifecycle management and compliance with lending policies.
* Experience in Finance and Portfolio Management, with the ability to assess credit risk, monitor asset quality, and optimize portfolio performance.
* Demonstrated Customer Service skills, with a focus on clear communication, issue resolution, and relationship management.
* Previous experience in asset-based lending, retail or MSME lending, or related financial services roles.
* Understanding of banking and NBFC operations, especially in rural or semi-urban markets, is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field; relevant certifications in lending or credit management are beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site in Sardhana, collaborate with field teams, and manage multiple priorities with attention to detail.
* Proficiency with basic office software and loan management systems; familiarity with digital financial platforms is preferred.

title: FP&A Analyst
description:
**We’re hiring at Pitney Bowes, where top talent builds meaningful careers and lasting impact. We Move fast, Deliver excellence, and Win together…that’s The Pitney Bowes way. Here, how we work matters just as much as what we achieve.**
**We’re Looking For People Who**

* Act with urgency, accountability, and purpose
* Deliver high quality work with consistency and pride
* Collaborate effectively and elevate those around them
* Focus on outcomes that drive impact and growth

**Job Description**
**Job Title - FP&A Analyst**
**Experience - 5–7 Years**
**Location - Hybrid**
**Role - Third Party Payrolls**
**Position Summary**
The FP&A Analyst will own budgeting, forecasting, actuals reporting and variance analysis for assigned Engineering, IT and non-engineering cost centers and projects. The role also supports month-end closing activities, headcount reporting, project finance (WBS, capitalization, Workday Projects) and ad-hoc / scenario-based analysis for India leadership (SMT), Engineering Directors and global finance teams. The ideal candidate is hands-on, detail-oriented and comfortable working in Workday Adaptive Planning, SAP and advanced Excel to deliver accurate, timely and well-explained numbers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Budgeting & Forecasting**
Prepare annual budgets and monthly forecasts for assigned cost centers and projects; load them into the planning system; run scenario analysis.
  
  
**Variance Analysis**
Analyze actuals vs budget, prior forecast and prior year (monthly and YTD), with bridges and clear commentary.
  
  
**Headcount Reporting**
Consolidate and report headcount; align with approved positions and budget; reconcile to cost centers.
  
  
**Month-End Close**
Support month-end close, including journal entries, accruals and reconciliations, in coordination with the accounting team.
  
  
**Project Finance & Capitalization**
Set up WBS projects in SAP; monitor AUCs and quarterly releases to Fixed Assets; run amortization simulations; support Workday Projects (budget setup, resource and project loading, labor-rate tie-outs); reconcile Workday Projects to SAP; support mid-year project labor absorption and cap rates; maintain the Plan of Record (POR) repository for NPD/NFD projects.
  
  
**Reporting & Ad-hoc Analysis**
Prepare management reporting packages and dashboards; deliver ad-hoc and business case analysis for leadership.
  
  
**Controls & Documentation**
Keep reconciliations and audit support current; maintain process documentation.
  
  
**RECURRING DELIVERABLES**
**Month-end close & journals**
Accurate, on-time close support
  
  
**Actuals & variance reporting**
Variances vs budget, prior forecast, prior year
  
  
**Forecast & headcount reporting**
Forecast load and headcount reconciliation/ reporting BU wise
  
  
**Project reporting & reconciliations**
Project actuals, variances, bridges; Workday Projects-to-SAP reconciliations and tie-outs; WD Project Systems forecast
  
  
**WBS project set-up & AUC monitoring**
SAP WBS set-up; AUC monitoring and releases to Fixed Assets
  
  
**Budget preparation & scenarios**
Annual budget load and scenario analysis
  
  
**Experience**
**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**
5–7 years in FP&A, business finance or financial analysis, ideally in a corporate / captive / GCC environment with budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis ownership
  
  
**Must have**
**Education**
Bachelor's in Commerce, Finance or Accounting; MBA, CA, CMA or CFA preferred
  
  
**Excel & modeling**
Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, SUMIFS, multi-tab models); strong variance, bridge and scenario modeling skills
  
  
**Planning tools**
Hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning (or similar EPM tool) for forecast and budget loads
  
  
**ERP / finance systems**
Working knowledge of SAP (FI/CO, WBS / project systems, fixed assets); exposure to month-end close and journal entries
  
  
**Communication**
Explains variances clearly to non-finance stakeholders
  
  
**BI / dashboards**
Power BI or Tableau
  
  
**Good to have**
**Headcount & cost center analysis**
Experience with HC planning, reporting and reconciliation
  
  
**Workday Projects**
Experience with Workday Projects set-up and reconciliation
  
  
**Capitalization & amortization**
Familiarity with AUC, capitalization and amortization simulations
  
  
**BI / dashboards**
Power BI or Tableau for dashboards and reporting
  
  
**Communication**
Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain variances to non-finance leaders and global teams
  
  
**Working style**
Detail-oriented, deadline-driven, self-starter, comfortable with multiple recurring cycles and ad-hoc requests
  
  
**SUCCESS MEASURES**

* Accurate, on-time close, forecast and budget deliverables.
* Clear variance commentary and clean reconciliations.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and audit readiness.

**About Pitney Bowes**
Pitney Bowes (NYSE: PBI) is a global shipping and mailing company that provides technology, logistics, and financial services to more than 90 percent of the Fortune 500. Small business, retail, enterprise, and government clients around the world rely on Pitney Bowes to remove the complexity of sending mail and parcels. For additional information visit Pitney Bowes at www.pitneybowes.com.
  
  
**We Will**

* Provide the will: opportunity to grow and develop your career
* Offer an inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
* Deliver challenging and unique opportunities to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
* Offer comprehensive benefits globally (PB Benefits and Wellbeing Programs)

Pitney Bowes is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusiveness in the workplace.
  
  
All interested individuals must apply online.
